section.name: Apache Tomcat JK Connectors vulnerabilities
section.p: This page lists all security vulnerabilities fixed in released versions of the Apache Tomcat JK Connectors.

section.name: Fixed in Apache Tomcat JK Connector 1.2.50
section.p: Incorrect default permissions for the memory mapped file configured by the JkShmFile directive on Unix like systems.
Affects: JK 1.2.0-1.2.49 (mod_jk on Unix like platforms only)
